**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 12 — Specifications and Warranty).**

What I found:
- **Duration is already compliant** — p0086 warrants Software conformance to Specifications for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter while under Maintenance Services. That meets/exceeds the preferred 12-month software warranty.
- **No disclaimer risk** — the agreement contains no "AS IS" or implied-warranty disclaimer, so nothing swallows the express warranty.
- **Gaps:** Section 12 provides no remedy. The only repair path is Garman's "best efforts" repair under Software Repair Service (p0077), which is chargeable in five listed situations and offers no replacement or refund; the refund/rejection right (Sections 7–8) expires with the acceptance period. There is also no professional-and-workmanlike warranty for Garman's services (installation, data conversion, training, maintenance), no no-malicious-code warranty, and no compliance-with-laws warranty.

Redline (validated ok:true): inserted a new paragraph after p0086 adding the services, malicious code and compliance warranties, plus an express repair/replace/re-perform remedy with a fee refund if Garman fails to cure within 30 days of notice. Comment flags the 90-day services-warranty fallback while holding firm on having a real remedy.
